resolution.rationale: The pilot review documents Lamezia as interception/arrest geography rather than the place where the underlying fraud/robbery occurred. Procedural geography must not be promoted to occurrence geography.

evidence.pilot_exclusion_reason: Lamezia is documented as interception/arrest area, not as occurrence location

regression_rule: No default map marker may be generated from arrest, interception, search, discovery or procedural location when occurrence geography is unresolved.
next_action: Retain permanently as a regression control unless independent evidence later establishes a Lamezia occurrence.
